role: Comparator that orders RenderLists (render chunks) by squared XZ distance from a camera chunk, nearest first.
scope_reason: RenderList ordering for the GL chunk renderers. The native renderer culls and orders sections by its own window and distance sorts (csrc/engine/raster.c water_section_compare sorts sections by distance; the draw-list build in raster_live does the culling).

members.name: compare
members.note: behavioural counterpart: the live path's section distance ordering, not a port of the RenderList sort
